reason: User clarified that rollover means one continuous all-in balance: $10 multiplied by odds for every consecutive win, with the entire accumulated balance lost on the next miss.
restart_policy: For season-wide reporting, a new $10 is deposited after each loss to show the next independent streak. Without a new deposit, the first loss ends the simulation at $0.
status: post-result accounting clarification; selection rules, odds, picks and outcomes unchanged
warning: No profit is realized unless the bettor cashes out. Rolling the full balance into a losing next selection makes that streak's ending balance $0.
